spLandmarkPolicy.note: sp_* anchors remain canonical provenance landmarks. They are NOT runtime spawn coordinates, NOT spawn compounds, NOT final seeded positions.

gameplayContract.algorithm: Choose a candidate region by Gameplay-owned policy, then seed a uniform sample over its cellIndices; project with the Gameplay-approved transform; reject on runtime collision/occupancy/claim/hazard; resample. Map never pre-selects the final point.

noClaims: NO pre-placed house, free shelter, starter crate or starting installation
NO starter resource stock or item list
NO Gameplay runtime collision or swept clearance verdict

transform.note: No rescale/crop/warp; runtime U=1.6 and U=2 are DIAGNOSTIC PROJECTIONS only.

source.note: GEO-01 250x175 uint8 rasters + canonical Veyra GOLD vectors; full 2000x1400 frame retained.
